definitions.gloss: hot spring cure; therapeutic bathing at a hot spring
definitions.explanation: The practice of staying at a hot spring for an extended period to treat illness or promote health. A traditional Japanese form of convalescence.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}で{湯治|とうじ}する。
examples.english: To take a hot spring cure.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{毎年|まいとし}{湯治|とうじ}に{行|い}っている。
examples.english: My grandmother goes for a hot spring cure every year.

examples.japanese: {湯治|とうじ}{場|ば}として{有名|ゆうめい}なこの{温泉|おんせん}には{長期|ちょうき}{滞在|たいざい}の{客|きゃく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This hot spring, famous as a therapeutic bathing destination, has many long-term guests.

notes: A traditional practice where people stay at hot springs ({温泉|おんせん}) for days or weeks to heal ailments. {湯治|とうじ}{場|ば} (therapeutic bathing spot) and {湯治|とうじ}{客|きゃく} (therapeutic bathing guest) are common compounds. Not to be confused with the homophones {冬至|とうじ} (winter solstice) or {当時|とうじ} (at that time). While modern day trips to hot springs are common, {湯治|とうじ} specifically implies extended stays for health purposes.
